cases.name: api-sha512-digest-sum-32
cases.notes: Only the named call and result assignment are timed; input/state preparation and output verification are outside counters. The pure Motoko sum mutates its receiver. The timed adapter constructs a clone with share/unshare and sums it, preserving the original state like the plugin API. Query checks that original state still hashes identically.
